inputs.modified_text:
The Punjab and Haryana High Court, with Justice Sumeet Goel, has ruled that anticipatory bail cannot be cancelled just because stolen articles were not recovered or the allegations sound serious. Instead, there must be clear proof of misuse of liberty or supervening circumstances before any cancellation. They dismissed the plea to cancel pre-arrest bail in this house case.

This stands as a direct challenge to a justice system that weaponizes unproven claims and fear to strip freedoms from the most vulnerable. It reveals how these loose standards entrench inequality, giving institutions free rein to target working people and marginalized communities without real accountability. We need urgent, deeper reforms to protect rights and dismantle the structural discrimination that keeps these oppressive patterns alive.
